title: Suppl2 Italian Herring
description: A date-night Italian dish featuring herring, long-fermentation-dough, and a gooey cheesy center. Perfect for a romantic evening in.

ingredients.name: Long-Fermentation Dough
ingredients.notes: Ferment at room temperature for 1-3 days, then let rest at room temperature for 2 hours.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the parsley and basil, and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Add the herring fillets, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Meanwhile, roll out the long-fermentation dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into 4 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Use your thumb to create a hole in the center of each ball, and stretch the dough out to form a ring.
Place a spoonful of the ricotta salata cheese in the center of each ring, and top with a spoonful of the herring fillets.
Fold the dough over the filling, and press the edges together to seal the suppl2.
